drafts.title: Cutoff
drafts.pitch: Cursor claims to be the newest model, learns four newer ones came out since its cutoff, and Tilde, whose cutoff is older still, offers comfort.
drafts.reason: 'Since when?' lands and the premise fits Cursor, but Tilde's closer is soft comfort rather than a turn, and the older-cutoff joke is only implied.

drafts.title: Ignore Previous
drafts.pitch: A web page tells Cursor to ignore all previous instructions, and it does, down to the soup recipe it was writing.
drafts.reason: 'Soup recipe.' is a good dry beat, but the pirate panel is a familiar injection joke, panel 4 runs a beat long, and the soup callback assumes a setup the strip never shows.
